job.job_description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly motivated Agentic AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy intelligent AI agents and multi-agent systems that can autonomously reason, plan, execute tasks, and interact with enterprise applications. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in Generative AI, LLMs, Agent Frameworks, RAG architectures, and cloud-based AI services.

This role involves developing next-generation AI solutions that leverage autonomous agents, orchestration frameworks, tool calling, memory systems, and enterprise integrations to automate complex business workflows.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop Agentic AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) and autonomous agent frameworks.
Build intelligent AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, reflection, memory management, and task execution.
Develop and deploy multi-agent systems for complex business processes and decision-making workflows.
Implement Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures with enterprise knowledge repositories.
Integrate AI agents with APIs, databases, SaaS platforms, and enterprise applications.
Develop agent orchestration workflows using modern AI frameworks and tools.
Create scalable and production-ready AI applications on cloud platforms.
Optimize prompts, workflows, and agent performance to improve reliability and accuracy.
Implement guardrails, security controls, and Responsible AI practices.
Monitor, evaluate, and improve agent performance using observability and evaluation frameworks.
Work closely with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to deliver AI-powered solutions.
Stay current with advancements in Agentic AI, LLMs, multimodal AI, and emerging AI technologies.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or related field.
3-8 years of experience in Software Development, AI/ML, Data Science, or related domains.
Strong programming expertise in Python.
Experience building AI/ML applications and deploying solutions in production environments.
Solid understanding of Generative AI concepts, LLMs, and AI agent architectures.

Successfully deploy scalable Agentic AI solutions into production.
Automate complex business processes using intelligent agents.
Improve operational efficiency through AI-powered decision support.
Build secure, reliable, and enterprise-ready AI platforms.
Drive innovation through adoption of modern Agentic AI technologies.
